data_tooling.name: build-your-own-x
data_tooling.summary: Build-Your-Own-X 是一个精心编排的教程集合，通过从零开始复现各种技术来教授编程，帮助开发者通过动手实践理解系统内部原理。其核心方法是将复杂系统分解为可学习的组件，展示基础概念如何组合成复杂工具的技术思路。你可以用它构建从数据库到游戏的各种项目，在探索常用工具底层原理的同时获得实用技能——这种“边做边学”的方式非常适合想要通过主动创造来深化编程理解的开发者，为技术成长提供了一条清晰的实践路径。
data_tooling.summary_en: Build-Your-Own-X is a curated collection of tutorials that teaches programming by recreating technologies from scratch, helping developers understand system internals through hands-on implementation. Its technical insight lies in breaking down complex systems into learnable components, demonstrating how foundational concepts combine to create sophisticated tools. You can use it to build anything from databases to games, gaining practical skills while exploring how your favorite tools work under the hood—perfect for deepening your programming knowledge through active creation.

ui_devex.name: SpacetimeDB
ui_devex.summary: SpacetimeDB 是一款可直接嵌入应用的关系型数据库，通过消除独立数据库服务器和复杂网络层来简化开发流程。其核心技术采用确定性事件溯源架构，将所有状态变化记录为不可变事件，实现了完美的数据复制和时间旅行调试功能。开发者可以用 Rust 编写业务逻辑模块在数据库内运行，特别适合构建多人在线游戏、实时协作工具或金融应用，系统会自动处理冲突并保持所有客户端状态一致性，让分布式系统开发变得像编写单机程序一样直观。
ui_devex.summary_en: SpacetimeDB is a relational database that embeds directly into applications, eliminating the need for separate database servers and complex networking layers. Its key innovation is using a deterministic, event-sourced architecture where all state changes are recorded as immutable events, enabling perfect replication and time-travel debugging. Developers can build multiplayer games, real-time collaborative tools, or financial applications by writing business logic in Rust modules that run within the database, with automatic conflict resolution and consistent state across all clients.

ui_devex.name: cc-switch
ui_devex.summary: cc-switch是一款跨平台桌面工具，解决了开发者同时使用Claude Code、Codex等多种AI编程助手时界面分散的痛点，通过统一平台整合不同服务。其技术亮点在于采用Rust语言开发，确保了高性能和稳定性，能够可靠地管理多个AI提供商的接口。用户可以通过它在一个应用中无缝切换不同AI编程工具，无需反复配置环境，非常适合在实际开发中快速对比和测试各模型的代码生成能力，提升编程效率。
ui_devex.summary_en: cc-switch is a cross-platform desktop tool that solves the fragmentation problem when working with multiple AI coding assistants like Claude Code and Codex by providing a unified interface. Its technical strength lies in being built with Rust, which ensures high performance and reliability for managing different AI providers through a single application. Developers can use it to streamline their workflow by switching between AI coding tools without changing environments, making it practical for experimenting with different models' coding suggestions directly in their development setup.

Its technical strength lies in being built with Rust, which ensures high performance and reliability for managing different AI providers through a single application. Developers can use it to streamline their workflow by switching between AI coding tools without changing environments, making it practical for experimenting with different models' coding suggestions directly in their development setup.
